# Derma Glo - Dermatology & Aesthetic Clinic
> https://dermaglo.com

## About
Derma Glo is a premier dermatology and aesthetic clinic in Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh, led by Dr. G. Lasya Priya (MBBS, MD DVL). We specialize in comprehensive skin, hair, and nail care with a focus on evidence-based treatments and personalized patient care.

## Services
- Acne Treatment & Scar Management
- Laser Hair Removal
- Anti-Aging Treatments
- Botox & Dermal Fillers
- Chemical Peels
- Pigmentation Treatment
- Hair Restoration
- Skin Rejuvenation
